# AstralyxPvP

> AstralyxPvP is a free India-based Java 1.9+ FFA Minecraft PvP server with custom skill-based ELO, live leaderboards, vote crates, and an active Discord community. Join on `java.astralyxpvp.int.yt`.

## Server Info
- IP: java.astralyxpvp.int.yt
- Versions: Minecraft Java 1.9 and above
- Region: India (optimized routes for Asia)
- Access: Free — cracked/offline mode clients supported
- Discord: https://discord.gg/u8BFrpRwEg

## How to Join
1. Copy the IP `java.astralyxpvp.int.yt`.
2. Open Minecraft → Multiplayer → Add Server.
3. Paste the IP and click Join.

## ELO & Leaderboard
Every kill and death in FFA and 1v1 arenas updates your rating through the custom plugin. See the live leaderboard at https://astralyxpvp.pages.dev/leaderboard

## Game Modes
- SWORDFFA (sword FFA arena)
- 1v1 arenas
- Vote crates and seasonal rewards
